shadows.name: focus-ring-glass
shadows.purpose: Focus on glass buttons over imagery.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single lit action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; background: #e5e5e5; color: #0a0a0a; font: 500 14px/1.4 sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fafafa; outline: none; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #262626; background: rgba(23,23,23,.8); color: #fafafa; font: 500 14px/1.4 sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fafafa; outline: none; }

components.name: Nav Pill
components.description: Floating top navigation; focus fills white.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; height: 64px; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(10,10,10,.75); } .ds-nav-item { height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #d4d4d4; font: 500 20px sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #fff; background: #ffffff14; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { background: #fff; color: #000; outline: none; }

components.name: Video Card
components.description: 16:9 thumbnail with title and subtitle; focus rings and scales.
components.html:
A video title that can run to two lines
Channel · 1.2M views
components.css: .ds-card { width: 240px; outline: none; } .ds-card-img { aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 8px; background: #171717; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 10px; font: 500 14px/1.4 sans-serif; color: #fafafa; } .ds-card-sub { margin-top: 2px; font: 12px/1.4 sans-serif; color: #a1a1a1; } .ds-card:focus .ds-card-img { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fafafa; transform: scale(1.03); }

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: Pill input; border goes white on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 999px; background: #171717; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #fafafa; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; background: none; border: 0; outline: none; color: #fafafa; font: 14px sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: YouTube Couch is a dark room with one lit screen. A cinematic hero previews the focused video; everything else stays dim, rounded, and out of the way. Rows of cards sit below the marquee and scroll on their own, so the cover never moves while the user browses.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas; content imagery supplies all the color.
Decisive white focus state on every focusable element.
One cover that stays put, with lists scrolling beneath it.
No shadows for hierarchy; gradients and blur carry depth.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue marks progress and selection only. Interactive affordances are white, never blue.

rules.name: The Imagery Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays neutral so thumbnails and the hero image provide the color. Do not add decorative hues.

rules.name: The Weight Over Size Rule
rules.body: Separate levels with weight and color (white vs. gray), keeping one family.

rules.name: The Flat Until Focused Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts at rest. Focus is the only state change that adds a ring, fill, or scale.

dos: Do make focus unmistakable from ten feet: white ring or white fill on every data-focusable element.
Do keep chrome neutral and let imagery carry color.
Do use pills for controls and 8px for imagery.
Do keep the cover fixed and scroll only the lists beneath it.
Do use backdrop blur plus translucent fill for controls over imagery.
Do raise text sizes toward distance legibility when touching 12px to 14px text; PRODUCT.md requires it.
donts: Don't use blue for buttons, links, or focus. It marks progress and selection only.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or buttons for hierarchy.
Don't turn glass buttons white on focus; they darken instead.
Don't add decorative accent colors or gradients to chrome.
Don't load webfonts; stay on the system stack for old TV hardware.
